name: 74501 · Mcalester, OK
findings: ZIP 74501 (Mcalester) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74501 (Mcalester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
